CustomField.label: Absence now or next 14 days
CustomField.description: SCRUM-457: "YES" while the mirrored absence is running today or starts within the next 14 days, blank otherwise. Formula field: re-evaluated at read time, so a shortened or cancelled absence follows immediately without a second write (AC6), and it drives the AC8 report filter without a relative-date filter.
CustomField.formula: IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Absence_End__c)) && NOT(ISBLANK(Absence_Start__c)) && Absence_End__c >= TODAY() && Absence_Start__c - TODAY() <= 14, "YES", "")
